evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's Brownfield Land Register page states that the register identifies previously developed land in Exeter that is suitable, available and achievable for residential development; it publishes a Brownfield Land Register 2025 map, downloadable register data under the Open Government Licence, and location plans for sites. These are planning-site/source-area records rather than individual physical building footprints, and the selected page exposes no record-level existing-building Polygon/MultiPolygon bound to explicit building type/use evidence.

field_evidence.footprint: The selected official register/map is for brownfield planning sites/previously developed land; site or location-plan boundaries are source-area/site extents, not individual physical building footprints, and no record-level building Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates are exposed in this window.
field_evidence.type_use: The page states residential-development suitability at site level, not explicit existing-building type/use bound to an individual building geometry.
field_evidence.semantics: source_area_count=1; no parcel/building progress credit; materialization/spatial join/import/publisher left to local OpenCode.
